title: National small amount credit contract regime and cost caps
summary: The national regime for small amount credit contracts commenced on 1 March 2013 and the cost caps (20% establishment fee, 4% monthly fee, 48% for other credit) on 1 July 2013, replacing state caps.

commenced.what: Schedule 3: small amount credit contract regime

direction_rationale: Caps limit what lenders can charge, protecting borrowers but possibly pushing small lenders out; the caps bind hardest where states had none.
comparison: Dose-response: NSW, the ACT and Queensland already capped all-in costs at 48%; Victoria partly; NT, SA, Tasmania and WA had no cap

verified.notes: Read on the Federal Register (as-made Act).
